objective: Determine whether certified rank >= 31 is reachable over a number field of degree 8, by attacking the measured binding constraint (base rank over Q) with a Mestre-style construction, and by measuring the coset structure that decides it. Either a degree-8 certificate or a measured ceiling closes the question.

handoff.objective: Construct elliptic curves over Q of the highest rank you can certify within budget, using a MESTRE-STYLE construction (build a curve through many prescribed rational points / force many simultaneous square conditions), NOT a quadratic-twist search. GOAL-ECRANK-001 measured the twist route: no twist of rank >= 5 in 364756 candidates, only 2 curves of rank 4 in 49692 enumerated. Target rank >= 6, stretch >= 8. Report the maximum ACTUALLY reached.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the binding constraint identified by DEC-20260822-5a5635 -- base rank over Q -- can be moved at all by a different construction.
constraints: EVERY rank you report is a certified LOWER BOUND from exhibited points. Never report an analytic rank, never report ellrank r_high, and never count a twist for which ellrank proved a bound but returned NO point (GOAL-ECRANK-001 saw exactly that: [1,1,0,[]]).
Verify independence of the exhibited points with a height pairing matrix and report the determinant; a singular determinant means the points are NOT independent and the rank claim drops accordingly.
cypari (bundled PARI 2.15.4) and numpy are installed; there is no Sage and no sympy.
A timeout or crash is an infrastructure outcome, NEVER negative mathematical evidence. Record it as such.
Write ONLY inside your write_scope. Never commit; the Coordinator archives.
Report the maximum rank you actually reached even if it is below target. An honest 4 is worth more to this campaign than an unverifiable 8.
deliverables: a JSON pool of constructed curves with, for each, the a-invariants, the exhibited independent points, and the height regulator determinant
a short report stating the construction used, the maximum certified rank reached, the search volume, and where the method stopped paying off
completion_gate: pool JSON parses and every listed rank is backed by that many exhibited points
every exhibited point verified on its curve in exact arithmetic by your own code
regulator determinant reported for every multi-point curve
handoff.return_format: executor execution report: what was run, what was measured, what failed, no interpretation of significance

tasks.title: Coset structure and k=3/k=4 optima on the committed pool

handoff.objective: Measure the COSET STRUCTURE that decides whether degree 8 is reachable. On the committed GOAL-ECRANK-001 pool: (1) reproduce the k = 3 optimum of 20 as a regression fixture; (2) extend the twist support beyond 7 primes and re-run the k = 3 and k = 4 optimisation; (3) measure, across cosets, how the k = 3 total decomposes into the maximum single-class rank and the contribution of the other 7 classes, and whether those two are separable.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the k = 3 total is approximately (max class rank) + (a constant), which is the assumption behind any claim about what base rank degree 8 would require.
constraints: REGRESSION FIXTURE FIRST: reproduce k = 3 optimum = 20 on the committed pool with support [-1,2,3,5,7,11,13] before reporting any extended-support number. If you cannot reproduce it, STOP and report that -- it means the committed result or your re-implementation is wrong, and either way nothing downstream is believable.
Certified counts only: a class contributes min(r_low, number of exhibited points).

When a coset representative shares primes with a class, XOR cancels them and the points must be transported by (u,v) -> (u t^2, v t^3). GOAL-ECRANK-001 shipped this wrong once; it was caught by the exact verifier. Get it right and test it.
Descent timeouts contribute ZERO and are counted separately as timed_out, never as rank 0.
Write ONLY inside your write_scope. Never commit.
deliverables: regression fixture result (k = 3 optimum on committed pool and support)
extended-support k = 3 and k = 4 optima with the support used
a table of cosets: max single-class certified rank vs total, with the separability question answered by data
the base rank that 31 at k = 3 would require under the measured relation, WITH the relation stated and its fit quality
completion_gate: regression fixture reproduced or explicitly reported as failed
separability question answered with a table, not an assertion
handoff.return_format: executor execution report: measurements only, no interpretation of significance

review_plan.claim_under_review: As the producers state it: (a) the maximum rank over Q reached by a Mestre-style construction within budget, certified by exhibited independent points; (b) the k = 3 and k = 4 twist-family optima on the augmented pool; (c) the base rank that reaching 31 at k = 3 would require, derived from measured coset structure.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: The Coordinator expects P1 and P2 to HOLD and P3 to HOLD: the Mestre construction should beat rank 4, the k = 3 optimum should rise above 20, and it should still fall short of 31. Recorded before any reviewer runs so that a concurring review is distinguishable from a review that agreed with what the Coordinator already believed. If the producers return 31 at k = 3 the prior is WRONG and that is the more interesting outcome.

joints.joint: Every rank attributed to a Mestre-constructed curve is a certified LOWER BOUND from exhibited points, never an analytic rank, a Selmer bound, or an ellrank r_high.
joints.attack_plan: Take each curve the producer claims has rank r and independently recompute: that r points are exhibited, that each lies on the curve in exact arithmetic, and that the r x r height pairing matrix is nonsingular. Where the producer cites ellrank output, check whether it used r_low or r_high -- GOAL-ECRANK-001 saw ellrank return [1,1,0,[]], a proven bound with NO point, which must contribute zero here.
joints.breaking_artifact: a claimed rank with fewer exhibited independent points than claimed

joints.joint: The reported k = 3 optimum is the true maximum over the enumerated space, i.e. the subspace enumeration is complete and the scoring indexes the curve it says it does.
joints.attack_plan: Re-derive the k = 3 optimum on the COMMITTED pool blind (see blind_rederivation) and require it to equal 20. Then attack the indexing directly: GOAL-ECRANK-001 shipped a build in which XOR cancellation put 16 transported points on isomorphic-but-different models, caught only by the exact verifier. Check the transport factor t is applied wherever a coset representative shares primes with a class.
joints.breaking_artifact: a coset whose recomputed score differs from the reported one

joints.joint: The claimed base rank needed for 31 at k = 3 is MEASURED, not assumed: specifically that the non-maximal-class contribution is separable from the maximal class.
joints.attack_plan: Attack separability directly. Find two cosets with the same maximum twist rank and materially different totals; if they exist, the extrapolation behind the claimed ceiling is invalid and the number must be withdrawn. Also check the claim is not fitted on the same cosets it is then validated on.
joints.breaking_artifact: two equal-max cosets with different totals, or a fit validated on its own training set

joints.joint: Any degree-8 result is reported as WEAKER IN KIND than the held degree-32 exact certificate, not as a strict improvement.
joints.attack_plan: At k = 3 the eigenspace argument certifies at most 8, so 31 must come from within-class multiplicities and therefore from numerically evaluated height regulators. Challenge any framing that presents a smaller degree as a strictly better result while silently trading an exact certificate for a numerical one. Check the cost table states both axes.
joints.breaking_artifact: a deliverable claiming improvement on degree while hiding the certificate downgrade

objects: the committed GOAL-ECRANK-001 pool at k = 3, whose optimum is KNOWN to be 20 -- a pipeline returning more on unchanged inputs has a scoring bug, not a discovery
a configuration built only from twists whose exhibited point sets are EMPTY (ellrank proved a bound but found no point), whose certified total is known to be 0
a configuration whose exhibited points are torsion, e.g. a 2-torsion point (x,0), whose certified contribution is known to be 0 under the Mazur check
proves_too_much.failure_signature: On each object the pipeline must return the known value. Any nonzero certified rank on the second or third object, or anything above 20 on the first with unchanged inputs and support, means the scorer is measuring itself.

blind_rederivation.quantity: the k = 3 optimum: the maximum over all cosets of all 3-dimensional subgroups V of the support group of sum over the 8 classes of the number of exhibited independent non-torsion points on the corresponding quadratic twist
blind_rederivation.parameters: the committed pool at experiments/EXP-ECRANK-e1e30e/runs/RUN-ECRANK-e1e30e-001/pool.json with support [-1,2,3,5,7,11,13]
